The import's re-sync (correctionOf dev-x, same figures) retires the merged row; live row dev-x-v2 alone, reportsVerdict null. With an effort on the re-sync (rpe allowed by the ADF observation shape): EASY [345,575] in weeks 4 and 5, nothing withheld; without effort P1 does not read it but history keeps 6.6 km unwithheld. q4-corr-disputed: app 11 km vs import 6.6 km, DISTANCE_DISPUTED, then the import's correction: [345,575]. q4-corr-race (rows as the engine keeps them): merged race no result; after the import's correction plan-race:dev-race-v2 6 km in 3000 s read as a race result, no effort needed.
